name: Geometric Implicit Neural Representation
definition: A geometric INR is a neural network $f: \mathbb{R}^3 \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ approximating a Signed Distance Function (SDF) of a regular surface $S$, such that $\|\nabla f\| \approx 1$. Its parameters $\theta$ are defined by minimizing a loss $L(\theta)=0$ that enforces geometric properties via the gradient $\nabla f$ and Hessian $H_f$.
summary: Geometric Implicit Neural Representation is a neural network approximating a Signed Distance Function, distinguished by enforcing geometric constraints like the Eikonal equation to ensure clean, regular surfaces.
